name: Jiraikei Joshi!? Honami-san
original_name: 地雷系女子！？ほなみさん
source:
On a lazy afternoon, the friend that my brother brought home turns out to be a "landmine girl"!  
The identity of the mysterious "landmine girl" is...!?  

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/31143]freem page[/url]]
